q: How many administrative states make up the Federal Republic of Nigeria? (P4)
explain: Nigeria has 36 states and one Federal Capital Territory (Abuja).

q: The main natural mineral resource that forms the backbone of Nigeria's export economy is ____. (P4)
explain: Crude oil found in the Niger Delta is Nigeria's chief export commodity.
hint: Fossil fuel drilled in the Niger Delta.

q: Which body of water borders the southern coast of Nigeria? (P4)
explain: Nigeria's southern coastline faces the Gulf of Guinea in the Atlantic Ocean.

q: The vegetation zone in southern coastal Nigeria dominated by swamps and mangrove trees is the ____. (P4)
explain: The coastal Niger Delta is characterized by lush mangrove ecosystems.
